Batch scrape with empty batch_urls array returns error

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    try {
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(null)
    val urls = listOf()
    val result = Crawlberg.batchScrape(engine, urls)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
